caption: The drawing depicts two scrimshaw whale teeth positioned side by side against a beige background with areas of discoloration. The left tooth is oriented horizontally and displays engraved images of four whales, each with a spout and some with tails visible above stylized waves. The right tooth is positioned vertically and features an engraving of a woman in a dress standing with an American flag in one hand and an anchor at her feet; below her, the word "HOPE" appears within an outlined rectangular section. The teeth are primarily a light brown color with shading and fine line work marking the engravings. The name "Carl Strelow" is written in faint cursive script below the two objects.
title: Whale's Tooth
